resources.string: Android asks you to allow a keyboard twice: once to add it, and again to choose it. Both steps are below.
1. Add Folio Keys in Android\'s settings

Android warns that a keyboard can see what you type. That is true of every keyboard — the system sends it your keystrokes. Folio Keys asks for no permissions at all, including no Internet permission, so what it sees cannot leave this phone.
Not added yet. Step 1 opens the list Android keeps of the keyboards it allows.
